page: Amazon Web Services c7i-flex.12xlarge is a compute-optimized server instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with an Intel Xeon 8488C processor running at 3.2 GHz. The configuration includes 48 dedicated vCPUs (24 physical cores with hyper-threading) and 96.0 GB of DDR5 memory operating at 5 GHz, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or a GPU, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 9 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate strong performance across several compute and memory-intensive workloads. The processor supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for integer and tile operations. In testing, the server achieved a Passmark CPU score of 65,056.32 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 19,030.0. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, with read-only cached small block transfers reaching 4,111.32 GB/sec and large block uncached reads at 222.1 GB/sec. For specialized tasks, the instance demonstrated strong capabilities in software compilation (45,495.0 on Geekbench) and LLM inference, generating 353.0 tokens per second on a small 135M model and 30.87 tokens per second on a medium 7B model.

The c7i-flex.12xlarge offers a cost-efficient profile within the compute-optimized tier by delivering high-density processing power and fast DDR5 memory without the added cost of bundled local storage or dedicated GPUs. This makes it a balanced choice for workloads that rely on network-attached storage and require high CPU throughput. Appropriate workloads include software compilation, database operations, static web serving, and CPU-based machine learning inference.
